title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Garden on 1973-04-02

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy show with a smoking Here Comes Sunshine and a knockout Eyes of the World jam.
ai_review.review: The concert is praised as an all‑around beautiful, tightly paced performance featuring Jerry Garcia at his exploratory best, standout moments like Here Comes Sunshine, the Weather Report Suite into Eyes of the World, and strong vocal work from Donna Jean. The soundboard source is clear with only minor interference from audience screaming and a tiny pre‑jam glitch, making it an enjoyable listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high 5‑star comments about the musical performance and only minor technical complaints; strong positive consensus across multiple detailed reviews.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear and balanced overall; slight bleed from Donna's screaming during Jerry's solo and a tiny cut in the pre‑jam of the Greatest jam, but no major issues.

standout_songs: Weather Report Suite > Eyes of the World
show_quality.setlist_flow: Tight, well‑structured set with a solid first set and an especially strong second set; the jam after Here Comes Sunshine is highlighted as a knockout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as sharp, explorative and blazing all night; his guitar tone and vocals receive high praise.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass work noted as supportive, especially on Box of Rain with Donna Jean.
band_member_comments.Bob: Generally solid (e.g., El Paso), though a missed break/bridge in the Weather Report Suite is mentioned.
